items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: I bought a banjo in two weeks' time and went on the Capitol and I made a week's trip with him, catching on, you know.

ctx.x: Right. Yes. Heard they played a lot of blues. Is that right? A lot of blues. Yes, that's right.

Well, then I was, when I went with him, I went on banjo. I had just taken up banjo. Well, I had taken up banjo. Uh, banjo player on the Seema Capitol. He was to leave. I can't call his name. I just, uh, well, I had taken up banjo.
